title: Beyond the Last Stop
summaryZh: Ava 和弟弟 Ben 為了學校節目搭火車前往燈塔，卻因誤聽轉車廣播來到錯誤的終點，只能在有限時間內尋找替代交通方式。

sentences.text: Ava had checked the train schedule three times before she and her younger brother Ben left home.
sentences.zh: Ava 在和弟弟 Ben 離家前，已經把火車時刻表確認了三遍。

sentences.text: They were traveling to Northpoint Lighthouse to record an interview with its keeper for their school podcast.
sentences.zh: 他們正要前往 Northpoint 燈塔，採訪燈塔管理員，為學校的 podcast 錄製內容。

sentences.text: The lighthouse keeper had set aside forty minutes for their interview before the building closed at five that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 燈塔管理員已在建築物當天下午五點關門前，為他們的訪談預留四十分鐘。

sentences.text: Ava carried the microphones, while Ben guarded a notebook filled with carefully prepared questions.
sentences.zh: Ava 帶著麥克風，Ben 則小心保管寫滿預先準備問題的筆記本。

sentences.text: Their mother offered to drive, but Ava wanted the trip to feel like a real assignment.
sentences.zh: 媽媽原本願意開車送他們，但 Ava 希望這趟旅程像一次真正的採訪任務。

sentences.text: At Central Station, the departure board showed their coastal train leaving from platform six.
sentences.zh: 在中央車站，出發資訊板顯示他們的海岸列車將從第六月台開出。

sentences.text: They found two window seats and watched apartment blocks slowly give way to green fields and distant hills.
sentences.zh: 他們找到兩個靠窗座位，看著公寓大樓逐漸被綠色田野和遠方山丘取代。

sentences.text: For the first hour, everything happened exactly as Ava had planned.
sentences.zh: 第一個小時裡，一切都完全照著 Ava 的計畫進行。

sentences.text: Near the coast, a noisy announcement from several old speakers told lighthouse passengers to transfer at Harbor End.
sentences.zh: 接近海岸時，一段從幾個老舊喇叭傳出的嘈雜廣播，通知前往燈塔的乘客要在 Harbor End 轉車。

sentences.text: Ben heard the word direct and told Ava that they should remain on board.
sentences.zh: Ben 聽見了「直達」這個字，便告訴 Ava 他們應該留在車上。

sentences.text: Ava thought the speaker had said something different, but the train doors were already closing.
sentences.zh: Ava 覺得廣播說的似乎不一樣，但列車門已經關上了。

sentences.text: They agreed to trust Ben's ears and continued past the station without asking anyone.
sentences.zh: 他們決定相信 Ben 的耳朵，沒有詢問任何人就繼續坐過了那一站。

sentences.text: Twenty minutes later, every other passenger stepped off at a quiet village called Seabrook.
sentences.zh: 二十分鐘後，其他乘客全都在名叫 Seabrook 的寧靜村莊下車。

sentences.text: The conductor looked surprised when Ava asked how many stops remained before Northpoint.
sentences.zh: Ava 詢問距離 Northpoint 還有幾站時，列車長露出驚訝的表情。

sentences.text: He explained that Seabrook was the final stop and Northpoint lay twelve kilometers behind them.
sentences.zh: 他解釋 Seabrook 就是終點站，而 Northpoint 位在他們後方十二公里處。

sentences.text: Ben opened the schedule again and finally noticed the small transfer symbol beside Harbor End.
sentences.zh: Ben 再次打開時刻表，終於注意到 Harbor End 旁邊那個小小的轉車符號。

sentences.text: The station clerk said the next bus toward the lighthouse would not arrive until evening.
sentences.zh: 車站職員說，下一班開往燈塔方向的公車要到傍晚才會抵達。

sentences.text: Their interview began in three hours, and walking the whole distance under the afternoon sun would take nearly as long.
sentences.zh: 他們的訪談三小時後開始，而頂著午後陽光走完全程也幾乎需要同樣久。

sentences.text: Ava blamed Ben for guessing, and Ben replied that she had heard the same unclear message.
sentences.zh: Ava 責怪 Ben 亂猜，Ben 則回說她也聽到了同一段不清楚的廣播。

sentences.text: For several uncomfortable minutes, they sat outside the station without speaking.
sentences.zh: 接下來尷尬的幾分鐘裡，他們坐在車站外，一句話也沒說。

sentences.text: A handwritten sign across the street listed bicycle repairs, maps, and cold lemonade.
sentences.zh: 街對面一塊手寫招牌列著腳踏車維修、地圖和冰檸檬水。

sentences.text: Ben pointed at two dusty bicycles standing beside the shop and suggested asking about them.
sentences.zh: Ben 指著店旁兩輛滿是灰塵的腳踏車，提議去問問看。

sentences.text: The owner, Omar, listened patiently while Ava described the missed transfer and their limited time.
sentences.zh: 店主 Omar 耐心聽 Ava 說明錯過轉車以及他們剩下的有限時間。

sentences.text: Instead of laughing, he unfolded a local map and showed them a narrow road along the shore with one finger.
sentences.zh: 他沒有嘲笑他們，而是攤開當地地圖，用一根手指指出沿海岸的一條狹窄道路。

sentences.text: Omar offered them the old bicycles if they promised to return them before his shop closed at seven.
sentences.zh: Omar 願意把舊腳踏車借給他們，只要他們答應在店家七點打烊前歸還。

sentences.text: He checked both brakes, raised Ben's seat, and placed a repair kit in Ava's basket.
sentences.zh: 他檢查兩輛車的煞車、調高 Ben 的座椅，並在 Ava 的車籃裡放了一套修理工具。

sentences.text: The coastal route was longer than the highway, but it was safe enough for bicycles.
sentences.zh: 沿海道路比公路更遠，但對腳踏車來說足夠安全。

sentences.text: Ava called the lighthouse office and left a message explaining that they might arrive late.
sentences.zh: Ava 打電話到燈塔辦公室留言，說明他們可能會遲到。

sentences.text: Then she apologized to Ben, who admitted that he should have asked the conductor sooner.
sentences.zh: 接著她向 Ben 道歉，Ben 也承認自己早該詢問列車長。

sentences.text: They tightened their backpack straps and repeated Omar's directions one final time.
sentences.zh: 他們拉緊背包帶，最後再複誦一次 Omar 指的方向。

sentences.text: As they rode away, the sea appeared beyond the rooftops like a bright silver path.
sentences.zh: 他們騎車離開時，海面在屋頂後方出現，像一條明亮的銀色小徑。

sentences.text: The mistake had changed their journey, but it had not ended their assignment.
sentences.zh: 這個錯誤改變了他們的旅程，卻還沒有結束他們的任務。

questions.q: Why did Ava and Ben remain on the train at Harbor End?
options: They believed the train would take them directly to Northpoint
They wanted to visit the village at the final stop
They were waiting for the lighthouse keeper to call

questions.q: Why was walking from Seabrook not a good solution?
options: The road was completely closed to pedestrians
It would use nearly all the time before the interview
Their recording equipment was too heavy to carry
He drove them to the lighthouse in his truck
He changed the time of their interview
He lent them bicycles and showed them a coastal route
